title: WTT Star Contender Muscat finals day preview: Odo v Akae and Hashimoto v Szőcs as Japan chase four titles
seo_title: WTT Star Contender Muscat finals preview and UK times
description: WTT Star Contender Muscat finals day: Odo v Akae, Szőcs v Hashimoto, Togami v Chen Yuanyu, Park v Oh and the mixed doubles final, with UK times.
standfirst: The semi-finals and finals of both singles draws are played on Saturday in Oman, with the mixed doubles final in between.
body: Japan have three of the four women left at WTT Star Contender Muscat and could win four of the five titles on Saturday, when the semi-finals and finals of both singles draws are played in Oman. Satsuki Odo plays Kaho Akae and Honoka Hashimoto plays Romania's Bernadette Szőcs in the women's semi-finals; Shunsuke Togami meets China's Chen Yuanyu and South Korea's Park Ganghyeon meets his compatriot Oh Junsung in the men's.

Play starts at 7am UK time (11am in Muscat). The mixed doubles final, with Togami and Odo against France's Esteban Dorr and Jia Nan Yuan, is at 9.30am, the women's singles final at 1.30pm and the men's at 2.10pm. Singles matches are now best of seven games. Neither of last year's champions is in Muscat, so both singles titles go to new winners.
## The big matches
**Satsuki Odo v Kaho Akae (7am UK)**

Odo, 22 and the world No 10, is the top seed and has already won the women's doubles with Sakura Yokoi. She won all four of her matches on Friday and dropped only 17 points in beating South Korea's Kim Nayeong in the quarter-finals. Akae, also 22 and ranked 36th, is in her first WTT semi-final above Feeder level after coming from two games down to beat Miyu Nagasaki, the fourth seed, 13-11 in the fifth. This is their first meeting in Eleven's records of WTT events since 2021.
**Bernadette Szőcs v Honoka Hashimoto (8.20am UK)**

Hashimoto, the 28-year-old Japanese defender, is the second seed and the world No 14 and has won eight matches in a row since the start of [WTT Contender Istanbul](/news/wtt-contender-istanbul-2026-finals-fang-bo-honoka-hashimoto-titles.html), which she won last Sunday. Szőcs, 31 and the world No 22, beat South Korea's Joo Cheonhui, the third seed, in four games on Friday. Hashimoto won their last meeting, 11-8 in the fifth game in the last 32 of the Singapore Smash in February, after losing the first two games.
**Shunsuke Togami v Chen Yuanyu (7.40am UK)**

Togami, 25 and the world No 15, has won the WTT Star Contender in Ljubljana and the WTT Contender in Almaty this year and has dropped one game in three matches in Muscat. Chen, 21 and the world No 29, is China's only player left in either singles draw, after beating Hiroto Shinozuka and then the qualifier Yuan Licen 11-5 in the fifth game.
**Park Ganghyeon v Oh Junsung (9am UK)**

Park, 30 and the world No 44, ended Sun Yang's run in the last 16 and then beat France's 18-year-old Flavien Coton 11-8 in the fifth game. Oh, 20, the fifth seed and the world No 19, beat Russia's Vladimir Sidorenko, the fourth seed, 3-0 in the quarter-finals and won the men's doubles title with Lim Jonghoon on Friday. Park beat Oh 3-1 in their only previous meeting in Eleven's records, in the last 16 of WTT Contender Zagreb in June.
## Japan's day

Japan have already won the women's doubles. One Japanese player is certain to reach the women's singles final, because Odo and Akae meet in the first semi-final, and Togami is in both the men's singles and the mixed doubles. Togami, Odo, Hashimoto and Shinozuka are all in Japan's eight-player squad for the [Mixed Team World Cup](/events/mixed-team-world-cup-2026.html) in Chengdu, which starts eight days later.
## Mixed doubles final

Togami and Odo beat Australia's Nicholas Lum and Yangzi Liu 12-10 in the fourth game of their semi-final. Dorr, 26, and Yuan, 41, knocked out the top seeds, Spain's Alvaro Robles and Maria Xiao, in the quarter-finals and beat Romania's Eduard Ionescu and Szőcs 3-1 in the semi-finals.
## Order of play
Times are approximate and UK time.

- 7am, women's singles semi-final: Satsuki Odo (JPN) v Kaho Akae (JPN)
- 7.40am, men's singles semi-final: Chen Yuanyu (CHN) v Shunsuke Togami (JPN)
- 8.20am, women's singles semi-final: Bernadette Szőcs (ROU) v Honoka Hashimoto (JPN)
- 9am, men's singles semi-final: Park Ganghyeon (KOR) v Oh Junsung (KOR)
- 9.30am, mixed doubles final: Esteban Dorr and Jia Nan Yuan (FRA) v Shunsuke Togami and Satsuki Odo (JPN)
- 1.30pm, women's singles final
- 2.10pm, men's singles final
## How to watch
WTT streams every match on its YouTube channel. Eleven's [event page](/events/wtt-star-contender-muscat-2026.html#matches) has live scores, the full draw and the order of play.
## Friday in brief

Park ended the run of the 18-year-old qualifier Sun Yang in five games, Akae came from two games down against Nagasaki, Odo and Yokoi won the women's doubles and Lim and Oh the men's. The full results are in Eleven's [day five review](/news/wtt-star-contender-muscat-2026-day-five-review-results-highlights.html).
